notes: A real spell-number 1 Armor affect expires through World.AffectUpdate and asserts the C literal plus CRLF before removal; spell number 0 remains silent as C requires (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).

A wizard switched into a blessed watcher receives "You feel less righteous." once when the affect expires: C's send_to_char reaches victim->desc, which do_switch set to the wizard's descriptor, and the last-record condition silences the second bless record (R1/R2/R3/R5e/R5h).
Two spells expiring together speak in C's newest-first ch->affected order (OrderedAffects), each delivered to the switched body's descriptor (R1/R3/R5e/R5h).
A two-record bless affect speaks once, proving the last-record condition suppresses the newer expiring record so a multi-record spell is not announced twice (R1/R3/R5e/R5h).

DP-1478. A God casts bless on a mortal: the spell stores two records (APPLY_HITROLL and APPLY_SAVING_SPELL, both duration 6) that expire the same mud hour. C's guard sends "You feel less righteous." once; the unfixed Go player loop sent it twice, and the mob path's RemoveAffectBySpell (affect_from_char, C's remove-all) removed every record of a spell at the first expiry. Expiry now unlinks exactly one record (RemoveAffectRecord) on both paths. Red retained at 2026-11-13/glm-dp1478-red.

Staggered self-casts of holy ward, invisibility, protection from evil, detect alignment, detect invisibility, detect magic, and sanctuary expire with their exact C spell_wear_off_msg[] lines; mutating spell_wear_off_msg[20] in pkg/game/constants.go fails l1-constants-6-depth (R1/R5e/R5h).

SPELL_DETECT_POISON is registered with MAG_MANUAL only and spell_detect_poison checks IS_AFFECTED/GET_OBJ_VAL without calling affect_to_char, so spell_wear_off_msg[SPELL_DETECT_POISON] ("The detect poison wears off.") is unreachable in C (R4/R5e).

DP-1530. Three detects cast together expire the same mud hour; C's prepend list speaks newest-first (detect magic, detect invisibility, detect alignment) while the unfixed Go spoke oldest-first. The whole player list is newest-first now — AddAffect and JoinAffect prepend, stat's compensated reversal is gone, the save stores the array newest-first and restoreAffects prepends like store_to_char (db.c:2474-2480). Red retained at 2026-11-14/glm-dp1530-red.

Unreachable in C: slot 0 ("RESERVED DB.C") is TYPE_UNDEFINED, and slots 41 (SPELL_VENTRILOQUATE) and 47 (SPELL_GROUP_ARMOR) have no spello registration or spell_level grant, so affect_update never expires them (R5e).

Unreachable in C: instant damage/area/point spells (slots 5,6,10,15,16,22,23,25,26,27,28,30,32,37,46) route through MAG_DAMAGE, MAG_AREAS, MAG_POINTS, or MAG_UNAFFECTS (SPELL_HEAL has no mag_affects case) and never call affect_to_char with their spellnum (R5e).

Unreachable in C: instant unaffects/creations/summons/group spells (slots 9,12,14,35,43,45,48,49) route through MAG_UNAFFECTS, MAG_CREATIONS, MAG_SUMMONS, or MAG_GROUPS (which delegates to child spellnums) and never attach an affect under their own spellnum (R5e).

Unreachable in C: MAG_MANUAL spells (slots 2,11,13,24,31,40,42: teleport, control weather, create water, enchant weapon, locate object, summon, word of recall) execute one-shot manual effects without calling affect_to_char (R5e).

Staggered casts of strength, sense life, infravision, waterwalk (on actor) and charm person, blindness, curse, poison, chill touch, sleep (on mortal peer) expire with their exact C spell_wear_off_msg[] slots [4,7,8,17,33,38,39,44,50,51]; mutating spell_wear_off_msg[51] in pkg/game/constants.go fails l1-wearoff-1-depth (R1/R5e/R5h).

Unreachable in C: the instant damage/area/point spells (slots 61 mindpoke, 62 mindblast, 71 mindattack, 83 soul leech, 92 disrupt, 93 disintegrate, 100 psiblast; 75 acid blast via mag_areas; 67 vitality, 68 invigorate, 77 cell adjustment, 89 lay hands) route through MAG_DAMAGE, MAG_AREAS (magic.c:1559 -> mag_damage) or MAG_POINTS (magic.c:1754), none of which calls affect_to_char/affect_join, so no affect record is ever typed with their spell number and affect_update never speaks their wear-off line (R5e).

Unreachable in C: the MAG_MANUAL spells (slots 54 lycanthropy, 55 vampirism, 56 sobriety, 58 hellfire, 59 enchant armor, 60 identify, 78 zen, 79 mirror image, 84 mindsight, 87 gate, 90 mental lapse, 94 calliope, 101 coc) dispatch through MANUAL_SPELL to bodies that carry no affect_to_char/affect_join at all -- zen stuns and heals instantly, mirror image spawns the clone mob, gate builds its portal, coc/conjure-style manuals act on objects or mobs -- so no affect record is typed with their own spell number (R5e).

Unreachable in C: every application stores an affect under a different spell number. 52 mass heal sets MAG_AFFECTS but mag_affects has no MASS_HEAL case, so the zeroed af array never joins; 57 group invis routes perform_mag_groups (magic.c:1447-1448) into mag_affects with SPELL_INVISIBLE; 76 dominate is MANUAL_SPELL(spell_charm) (spell_parser.c:506-507) and spell_charm stores af.type = SPELL_CHARM (spells.c:453); 80 mass dominate is MAG_AREAS (spell_parser.c:1480-1481) and mag_areas charms each valid target through spell_charm, again typed SPELL_CHARM (magic.c:1617-1618) (R5e).

Unreachable in C: 85 transparency and 98 slow have mag_affects cases (magic.c:1071, 1049) but no route can cast them -- neither spell has a spell_level grant in class.c:772-1074 and no potion, scroll, wand or staff in lib/world/obj carries spell 85 or 98 in values 1-3 (obj scan); 103 drowning has no spello registration at all -- SPELL_DROWNING is only a damage attacktype (comm.c:713-720), never an affect type, so no record can carry it (R5e).
